classification.difficultyReason: Class centres, product columns and the mean formula are supplied, so students multiply, total and substitute, rounding the non-exact result as instructed.

content.prompt: Complete these grouped frequency tables to calculate the mean. Give any non-exact mean to 1 decimal place.

inlines.text: Multiply each frequency by its class centre, add the products, and divide by the total frequency.
